$comment: Life events about money (D-068). Money moves only through the ledger: to or from sys:economy, an org account, `employer`, `here` or `landlord`; a choice that costs money says so and is refused if you can't pay.

events.title: Twenty on the pavement
events.prompt: A twenty-dollar bill is lying face up on the pavement, flapping a little in the breeze. Nobody's around. Nobody's looking.

outcomes.text: Finders keepers. You feel lucky all afternoon.

choices.label: Leave it for whoever dropped it

outcomes.text: You leave it. Somewhere, someone is about to retrace their steps and have a very good day.

events.title: A dropped wallet
events.prompt: A leather wallet on the kerb. Inside: $60, a library card, and a photo of a grinning dog in a party hat.

choices.label: Keep the cash, bin the wallet

outcomes.text: You take the $60 and drop the wallet in a bin. The dog in the party hat haunts you a little.

memory.text: Kept the cash from a stranger's wallet.

choices.label: Hand it in at the police station

outcomes.text: Two days later an envelope arrives: a thank-you card, a $25 reward, and a new photo of the dog.

memory.text: Handed in a lost wallet and got a thank-you from its owner.

outcomes.text: The desk sergeant logs it with a nod. You never hear another word, but you sleep fine.
Not your wallet, not your problem. You walk on. You think about the dog later.

events.title: Your account has been locked
events.prompt: A text: "LIVÉRA SAVINGS: Unusual activity. Verify within 1 hour or your account will be FROZEN." There's a link. The spelling is almost right.

outcomes.text: The page asks for your card number. You give it. Twenty minutes later, $180 is gone and the number doesn't answer.

memory.text: Fell for a scam text and lost $180.

outcomes.text: The page won't load. You look at it again and see "Livera Savngs." Close call.

memory.text: Nearly fell for a scam text.

outcomes.text: The real bank has no idea what you're talking about. "Delete it," they say. "And well done."

memory.text: Spotted a scam text before it got me.

outcomes.text: Delete. Block. Next.

events.title: Feeling lucky?
events.prompt: By the till, the scratch cards are fanned out like a magician's trick. "Win up to $500!" $5 a go.

outcomes.text: Lemon, lemon, cherry. Nothing. Of course nothing.
Three bells! $10. You've doubled your money and feel like a financial genius.
You scratch the last box and make a noise you didn't know you could make. $500.
You keep your five dollars. The house sulks.

events.title: The game in the back
events.prompt: Through a door you hadn't noticed, four people are playing cards under one bulb. "Buy-in's fifty. Cash." A chair scrapes back for you.

outcomes.text: You play tight, then you play lucky. You walk out $70 up and trying not to grin.

memory.text: Won at cards in the back room.

outcomes.text: You lose the fifty in nine hands, mostly to a quiet woman who says "sorry, love" every time.

memory.text: Lost $50 at cards in the back room.

outcomes.text: You watch, you learn, you keep your money. The quiet woman wins everything.
You close the door. Somewhere behind it, someone says "sorry, love."

events.title: The pairing
events.prompt: The waiter leans in. "May I suggest the wine pairing tonight? Four glasses, chosen by the chef. $45."

outcomes.text: Each glass arrives with a little speech. By the third you're nodding like you understand tannins.
"Tap water is fine." The waiter's smile doesn't move a millimetre.

events.title: The busker
events.prompt: A busker on the corner is playing the song your mother used to hum while she cooked. You stop walking without meaning to.

outcomes.text: You drop a five in the case. The busker nods and plays the bridge slower, just for you.

memory.text: Heard my mother's song played on a street corner.

outcomes.text: You stay to the end. It's the best four minutes of your week.
You keep walking. The tune follows you for two blocks.

events.title: "Tenant damage"
events.prompt: Your landlord's email: the heater that's been rattling since you moved in has died, and it's "clearly tenant damage." The bill is $120.

outcomes.text: You pay. The heater works. Your resentment does too, quietly, all winter.

memory.text: Paid my landlord for a heater that was already broken.

outcomes.text: You send the photos from move-in day, timestamped. A day later: "Our mistake. Fixed at no charge."

memory.text: Won an argument with my landlord.

outcomes.text: Three emails later, you're paying half and they're "doing you a favour."

memory.text: Split a repair bill with my landlord after a fight.

choices.label: Ignore it and wear a jumper

outcomes.text: You ignore the email and dig out your thickest jumper. It's fine. It's fine.

events.title: The rattling tin
events.prompt: A kid with a gap-toothed smile rattles a tin at you: "For the Common Ground food pantry!"

outcomes.text: The kid shrieks "THANK YOU" loud enough to turn heads. You feel ten feet tall.

memory.text: Gave to the Common Ground food pantry.

outcomes.text: You tip in your loose change. It rattles impressively for what it is.
"Sorry, no cash." The kid's smile holds. Yours doesn't.
